messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] High error rate on /v1/generate for project redwood-prod (p95 latency spike + 502 errors) — triggered by RTT threshold. Incident ID: INC-2026-03-15-001
ops-bot: paging channel: @oncall (mike thompson) — please acknowledge within 5m
jen liu: acked. I'm looking at the gateway logs now, seeing surge of 502s and a backlog on one of the GPU pools.
mike thompson: on it. quick checks: is this multi-region? any deploy in last 30m?
alex martinez: I did a small model roll today at 22:10 but it was staged to canary config for redwood-eu only, not prod. no full deploys to prod in last hour.
sarah cho: adding context — customer traffic pattern shows a large batch job hitting embeddings endpoints about the same time (ref: partner-sync). Could be cross-impacting shared infra.
jen liu: confirmed: errors correlated with a specific serving host node (gpu-24). KV cache pressure + continuous batching spike caused the worker to OOM and restart loop.
jen liu: mitigation attempt 1 — cordon gpu-24 from LB and drain gracefully (in progress)
incident-bot: gpu-24 drain started by jen liu at 2320004350. Expected drain time ~30s
ops-bot: temporary mitigation: routing policy changed to avoid pool-A; enabling fallback to quantized model variant (q4) for low-latency routes to prevent user-visible errors.
mike thompson: routing change applied. monitoring for errors/latency now. please hold on customer comms until we confirm stability (unless they ask).
cs-aliya: heads up — we have an enterprise customer (BrightApps) on a dedicated plan who reported increased 502s; they asked for an update. need a short customer-facing line if we can't stabilize quickly.
sarah cho: preliminary status for statuspage: "Partial service disruption affecting text generation for a subset of requests. Engineers investigating; mitigation in progress."
jen liu: after reroute and drain, error rate dropped to baseline within 90s — p50/p95 latency slightly elevated but stable.
alex martinez: confirming: no user data exposed. root cause appears to be an OOM from a kernel codepath when handling large prefix KV windows under a specific batching pattern.
mike thompson: good. recommend: (1) send brief customer note, (2) post interim status on status.redwood.com with affected services, (3) keep incident open for RCA.
cs-aliya: draft for BrightApps (short): "We observed intermittent 502 errors impacting some generation requests between 22:25–22:27 UTC. Our on-call engineers applied a routing mitigation; service is now stable. We are preparing a follow-up with root cause and preventative actions. Want us to include any timeline details or offer a credit?"
jen liu: timeline for internal RCA notes: event start 22:24:31 UTC, spike detected 22:25:09, drain initiated 22:25:40, errors normalized 22:27:12.
sarah cho: preventing followups: we should add immediate guardrails — limit KV prefix window to X tokens for continuous batching and add OOM detection alert to catch similar regressions earlier.
alex martinez: agreed. long term fix: adjust kernel memory accounting and add throttling when prefix+batch size exceeds safe thresholds. will need a patch and canary rollout (~2 weeks).
cs-aliya: ok I'm going to send the short note to BrightApps and cc their CSM. any objections?
mike thompson: fine to send the short note. mention that we're offering to discuss an SLA credit if they experienced user impact. cc:security? not necessary for this event.
cs-aliya: sending now. message sent at 22:40 UTC. (copy pasted below)
cs-aliya: "Hi BrightApps team — We observed intermittent 502 errors affecting some generation requests between 22:25–22:27 UTC. Our on-call engineers applied a routing mitigation and the service is stable. We're preparing a follow-up with a root-cause analysis and preventative actions; we'll share that within 48 hours. If you saw customer impact and would like us to assess available SLA remedies, let us know and we'll prioritize."
jen liu: thank you. I'll draft the internal RCA summary for the 48h follow-up.
jen liu: internal RCA summary (short): "Cause: OOM on a single serving node due to unbounded KV prefix + continuous batching interacting with kernel memory accounting bug. Impact: subset of generation requests returned 502 between 22:25–22:27 UTC. Mitigation: drained affected node and rerouted traffic to quantized fallback, restoring service. Remediation: immediate guardrail + alert, short-term kernel memory accounting patch, longer-term throttling/capacity improvement and canary rollout."
sarah cho: add estimated customer impact metric: ~0.03% of overall requests for that minute window were affected; BrightApps reported ~12 failing requests.
jen liu: preventative actions list (to include in follow-up):
- Add OOM sentinel alert for serving worker restarts and correlate with 5xx error rate (owner: eng-runtime; ETA: 3d)
- Implement KV prefix upper bound in batching layer (owner: eng-runtime; ETA: 5d)
- Patch kernel memory accounting to avoid under-estimating memory reserved by attention caches (owner: eng-ml; ETA: 2w)
- Canary rollout plan for the patch with automated rollback (owner: eng-platform; ETA: 3w)
- Post-incident review and update playbooks for routing fallback priorities (owner: eng-sre; ETA: 1w)
- Offer SLA credit guidance template for CS (owner: finance + legal; ETA: 2d)
cs-aliya: I formatted that into a customer-friendly RCA bullet list and will attach it to the follow-up email.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-03-15-001 status changed to "mitigated" by mike thompson at 2320004460
mike thompson: wrapping up. leaving short action items for owners. Jen, Alex, Sarah — please keep updates here and ping if anything changes.
cs-aliya: planned follow-up cadence: quick RCA summary to BrightApps within 48h, full technical RCA + timeline within 7 days. I'll schedule the customer check-in for tomorrow EOD to answer questions.
alex martinez: I'll open a PR for the kernel accounting patch and link it here once ready.
jen liu: noted. final note: thanks for fast ack/coordination, team. filing incident notes to postmortem bucket.
cs-aliya: closing slack thread for external comms draft. will update thread_ts 2320004321 with final RCA link when available. :white_check_mark:
